summary.text: Jason Zachary is a Republican state representative who has represented Tennessee House of Representatives District 14 since August 24, 2015, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Zachary's professional experience includes serving as vice president of Americomm, a telecommunications firm.
In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Calendar and Rules, Commerce, and Finance, Ways, and Means committees, and he chaired the Calendar and Rules Committee in 2019-2020 and 2021-2022.
Zachary and his wife, Holly, have a son, Tyson.
